If you ran into something and want to discuss publicly, feel free to open a thread here. I will DM you. Thanks! Dev updates week #3 | 31.7.-6.7. I spoke to Ben Edgington about this a while ago, it's on my very long TODO project list (effectively a black hole)... completely forgot about it until now. Very cool... if there's time in the EPF are we allowed to contribute to a second project ad-hoc? excerpts.author: eniko1555
excerpts.content:
Hello <@686695036733227017> 

Just wanted to update you that I now have a two-week window to review the project proposal for the deb repository. During this time, I've gathered some questions and developed a basic understanding of how this project should unfold.

By the way, people were just discussing setting up the node. Considering that, should we open a thread here (on Discord) to discuss the questions, or would you prefer if I DM you directly?

excerpts.author: tmiychao
excerpts.content: Great, thanks for sharing! If you ran into something and want to discuss publicly, feel free to open a thread here.

excerpts.content: I spoke to Ben Edgington about this a while ago, it's on my very long TODO project list (effectively a black hole)... completely forgot about it until now. Very cool... if there's time in the EPF are we allowed to contribute to a second project ad-hoc?

excerpts.content: Sure you can contribute to various projects, it's all up to you, just keep in mind keeping the scope of your work doable

You can also use geth's built in devp2p tool to gather connectivity related status and info:
`./devp2p rlpx ping enode://.....`
